column11:
The quizzes with the inflexible syntax checking are inconsistent and not helpful to me.  It becomes a frustrating exercise in translating a command sequence in know quite well into a "slice and dice” fill in the blanks.  Are the () included in this question?  Is the assignment <- needed for this one?  How about (parens)?

The color_names variable list on the exercise has errors in syntax where the comma is inside the quotes instead of outside -  "TARDIS Blue,”
I believe al the colors were listed with the same syntax.

I discovered that cutting and pasting a list from the exercise to the source window was hit or miss.  I had difficulty pasting the hexadecimal color codes into the source window.  I kept getting an unexpected end of file error and unmatched bracket errors when they were in fact matching.  I suspect that it was caused by copying some unprintable formatting characters from the browser to the source window.  I ended up copying the hex codes into a really simple text editor (Plain Text Editor) that doesn’t support RTF formatting and then copying from the text editor to the source.  That worked well.
